explanation: This function is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format(top_num) embeds top_num directly into the LIMIT clause of cmd. Crafted input in top_num could alter the SQL query structure to leak unauthorized records. The repair replaces .format() with a %s placeholder and passes data = [top_num, ] separately to execute_query(), though complete safety depends on the unseen execute_query implementation.
